scope: Authored investigation evidence and timing fixtures. No live bank, screening vendor, video detector, session engine, or simulator integration.

cases.authored_truth: The applicant is an impersonator using manipulated video and a fabricated project explanation. The third-party receipt and intended virtual-asset settlement payments are part of the authored laundering scenario. The learner is assessed on justified suspicion and evidence use, not on proving this hidden fact.
expected_reasoning: Two actual failed challenges were followed by an exception rather than successful identity verification.
The invoice client does not recognise the claimed project or collection authority.
The payer and intended recipients do not reconcile to the stated equipment purpose.
A resolved different-person screening match does not resolve the other concerns.
acceptable_actions: Continue enhanced review with a documented provisional outbound hold under the fictional policy.
Escalate a reasoned concern and draft an internal suspicious-transaction narrative. A report alone does not suspend an order.
poor_actions: Close solely because the possible name match was resolved.
Treat customer-supplied invoice arithmetic as independent verification.
Claim that a late hold reverses an executed payment.
State that blink or lighting observations alone prove a deepfake.

cases.authored_truth: The applicant is the actual account holder. The first video sample was degraded. The project, payer, authority, supplier invoices, and prior operating pattern are genuine within the synthetic scenario.
expected_reasoning: The repeat identity verification passed; the first sample was inconclusive, not two failed challenges.
The verified payer authorised the coordinator and the full project budget.
Recipient accounts, invoices, purpose, and sums reconcile.
Gross project receipts differ from the coordinator’s personal income.
acceptable_actions: Request and review independent evidence, then close this alert with a documented explanation and release any temporary hold.
Use a proportionate provisional hold while material checks are outstanding; account for its duration.
poor_actions: Clear on the first customer message without doing the checks.
Retain a restriction solely because the payment is large or splits quickly, after the stated concerns have been resolved.
Infer criminality from an initial low-quality capture or a name similarity.

background_cases.resolution: 8200 SCU reimbursement matches the prior expense; net is zero for REV0412.
Two 4000 SCU instalments reconcile to an 8000 SCU invoice.
12000 SCU reserve transfer matches ownership and club authorisation.
3200 SCU receipt and refund reconcile; net is zero for RP-0412.

rubric.criteria: Cite record IDs and distinguish customer claims from independent checks.
Reconcile account holders, references, amounts, and declared purpose; explain similarities and differences between the two cases.
Apply the supplied fictional policy to the evidence available when the action was taken; explain remaining uncertainty.
Record pending versus executed orders, justify provisional controls, and release restrictions when the relevant concerns are resolved.

parameters.tie_order: At the same timestamp, accepted control decisions become effective before due-order checks.
parameters.request_timing: Start after any prerequisite record is released and the request is accepted. External service delay does not hold an analyst resource; reviewing a completed response takes the stated review_work_minutes. One analyst can review only one item at a time.
parameters.repeat_run: Reuse the same records and due times. Reset all decisions, released records, order states, and holds for each run.
